research_rationale:
Producer-reviewed proposal only, not independent or human certification. The complete official original for EO:11087 assigns ongoing State Department preparedness functions and supporting coordination, research/evaluation, limits, and delegation. Its full sections 1–8 are retained in exact, disjoint inventory corrections because OCR segmentation omitted sections. The assignments are continuing capabilities, not a finite report or task. EO 11490 section 3015 names this order and immediately revokes it on 1969-10-28; section 3014 expressly excepts section 3015. Comparable functions under the new order derive from its new assignment, not survival of the old EO. The bounded held-source later-event search disclosed no earlier ending, revival, or current predicate for this order; that is a bounded research conclusion, not an exhaustive proof of every legal event.

savings.reason: EO11490 section 3014 begins Except as provided in Section 3015, so its retained-authority rule does not save this named revoked order. Original EO:11087 contains continuing preparedness assignments and a prior-inconsistency priority rule, not an express accrued-right or continuing-independent savings clause. Similar preparedness functions reissued under EO11490 are separately authorized. Historical plans and completed steps are not asserted to disappear, but no independently enforceable residual attributable to this EO was located in the bounded sources.
